g.title: HR_SALARYREVIEWPARTSNAPSHOT
g.text: Salary Review Participant Snapshot - For each participant, this entity takes a snapshot of relevant attributes at the reference date specified in the Salary Program. For “standalone” setup, this table gets normally imported.
The Identifier of the Salary Review Participant record.
The Identifier of the Labor Agreement record.
The Identifier of the Contract Level record.
The Identifier of the Location record.
The Identifier of the Job record.
The Identifier of the OrgUnit record.
The Identifier of the Cost Center record.
The Identifier of the Position record.
The Identifier of the Job Class record.
This list represents all grades that are used to define salaries.
The Identifier of the Performance Level record.
It’s the Performance score at the program snapshot date.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_SALARYREVIEWPARTICIPANT
g.text: Salary Review Participant - Reference to a person or company relationship who is eligible for a salary review.
The Identifier of the Salary Program Pool record.
The Identifier of the Person record.
The Identifier of the Company Relationship record.
